newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grain futures close lower on thin market.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grain futures close lower on thin market.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures closed lower on Friday at the end of a thinly traded session.
Traders said UK grain was still expensive when compared with other producers and this was resulting in slow export business.
"Our grain is still too expensive against most of Europe. The French market is holding steady, but every one else is cheaper than us," said one trader.
Wheat futures closed unchanged to 0.65 stg down after trading 359 lots.
Barley closed 0.25 to 0.15 stg lower on a turnover of 50 lots.
